subject.title: Feature Request: Configurable Session Lane Concurrency + Auto-Yield

question: Should OpenClaw allow parallel runs within the same session and/or automatic turn yielding, and what compatibility-safe config shape should expose that behavior?
rationale: The source confirms the requested behavior remains missing, but changing same-session concurrency or automatic yielding affects session ordering, cancellation, transcript safety, and public config semantics that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Design scheduler contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require a maintainer-approved contract for session ordering, cancellation, transcript writes, and config before implementation.

options.title: Split only diagnostics now
options.body: Let the lane-wait threshold continue through the narrower diagnostics PR while leaving concurrency and auto-yield unimplemented until separately designed.

options.title: Defer session parallelism
options.body: Document that /queue steering, /queue interrupt, subagents, and explicit sessions_yield remain the supported responsiveness paths for now.

recommendation.title: Design scheduler contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require a maintainer-approved contract for session ordering, cancellation, transcript writes, and config before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The history sampled for command queue serialization, concurrency defaults, and queue hardening points to this person as the strongest scheduler-contract routing candidate.
